ideas.title: Following the Money in Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial aspects of current federal investigations, including the joint narcotic investigation in Evansville and the investigation into Ohio State.
questions: What are the financial implications of these investigations?
How are the investigations being funded?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in these investigations could reveal important information about the scope and scale of the crimes being investigated. By analyzing financial records and transactions, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that could lead to further investigation and prosecution.
